patches.name: Logo packs
patches.description: Applies a preset app icon (all packs incl. Vanced Light). Turn off Morphe's Custom branding patch, both set the launcher icon.

patches.name: Logo packs
patches.description: Applies a preset app icon (all packs incl. Vanced Light). Turn off Morphe's Custom branding patch, both set the launcher icon. Use Custom icon with a folder for your own art.

patches.name: Overlay button style
patches.description: Player overlay button style (Bold / Rounded / Thin). Different buttons from Morphe's Player icon style patch, keep both on. Files whose references no longer exist in the app are skipped, so new app versions degrade to fewer styled buttons instead of failing.

patches.name: Shorts button style
patches.description: Shorts action button style. Stock leaves the app untouched. Turn off Morphe's Shorts icon style patch, both style the same buttons.
